# Wharf 0.13.0 implementation review

## Status

Implementation is validated for release.

## Findings

- Event streams are replayed through the existing schema and sequence
  validation before recovery planning.
- Completed logical attempts are excluded from resume.
- Deterministic failures are excluded; only explicitly retryable failures and
  unfinished attempts are resumed.
- Resume order is stable by immutable attempt ID.
- Infrastructure retry counts are reconstructed without generating new retry
  IDs.
- Live resources are reconciled and orphan IDs are reported explicitly.

## Validation evidence

Formatting verification, Release build, and the complete suite passed all 66
tests with zero warnings or errors.
